ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The bottom of the circuit is a common wire, which can be used as the reference ground. On the left side there is a 90 V voltage source, marked with the upper terminal as positive and the lower terminal as negative; its upper terminal is connected through a 6Ω resistor to the upper common node on the right side. The middle branch from this upper node downward is, in sequence, a 60 V voltage source and a 12Ω resistor; the 60 V source is marked with the upper terminal as positive and the lower terminal as negative. The right branch is a 36Ω resistor connected between the upper node and the bottom common wire, with an arrow beside it indicating that the current I direction is downward. Reasoning calculation: Take the bottom wire as ground, and let the node voltage at the upper terminal of the 36Ω resistor be V; then the desired downward current I = V/36. Calculate in two steps according to the superposition principle. 1) Keep only the 90 V power source, and short-circuit the 60 V power source. At this time, the upper node is connected through 6Ω to the upper terminal of the 90 V power source, and is grounded through 12Ω in parallel with 36Ω. The parallel equivalent resistance is 12Ω || 36Ω = 9Ω. Therefore, from voltage division, V_90 = 90 × 9/(6+9) = 54 V, so I_90 = 54/36 = 1.5 A. 2) Keep only the 60 V power source, and short-circuit the 90 V power source. At this time, the upper node is connected through 6Ω, 36Ω, and the middle branch containing the 60 V source and 12Ω. Write KCL for the upper node: V/6 + V/36 + (V - 60)/12 = 0. Multiplying both sides by 36 gives 6V + V + 3(V - 60) = 0, that is, 10V - 180 = 0, so V_60 = 18 V. Therefore I_60 = 18/36 = 0.5 A. Superposition gives I = I_90 + I_60 = 1.5 + 0.5 = 2.0 A.

Second keep only the 60 V source active and replace the 90 V source by a short: write KCL at the top node, V/6+V/36+(V-60)/12=0, to get V_60 and I_60=V_60/36. 图像描述：电路底部是一条公共导线，可作为参考地。左侧有一个90 V电压源，标注上端为正、下端为负；其上端通过一个6Ω电阻连接到右侧上方公共节点。中间支路从该上方节点向下依次是一个60 V电压源和一个12Ω电阻，60 V源标注上端为正、下端为负。右侧支路是一个36Ω电阻接在上方节点与底部公共导线之间，旁边箭头标出电流I方向向下。

推理计算：取底部导线为地，设36Ω电阻上端节点电压为V，则所求向下电流 I = V/36。

按叠加原理分两次计算。

1）仅保留90 V电源，将60 V电源短路。此时上方节点通过6Ω接到90 V电源上端，并通过12Ω与36Ω并联接地。并联等效电阻为 12Ω || 36Ω = 9Ω。因此由分压得 V_90 = 90 × 9/(6+9) = 54 V，所以 I_90 = 54/36 = 1.5 A。

2）仅保留60 V电源，将90 V电源短路。此时上方节点通过6Ω、36Ω以及含60 V源和12Ω的中间支路连接。对上方节点列KCL：V/6 + V/36 + (V - 60)/12 = 0。两边乘以36得 6V + V + 3(V - 60) = 0，即 10V - 180 = 0，所以 V_60 = 18 V。因此 I_60 = 18/36 = 0.5 A。

叠加得到 I = I_90 + I_60 = 1.5 + 0.5 = 2.0 A。

method.method_draft: Convert the left branch, as seen between the main top node and bottom node, from a 90 V source in series with 6Ω into a Norton source of 90/6=15 A in parallel with 6Ω injecting into the top node. Convert the middle 60 V source in series with 12Ω into a Norton source of 60/12=5 A in parallel with 12Ω injecting into the top node. Now the 6Ω, 12Ω, and 36Ω resistors are all in parallel, and by superposition the 36Ω branch receives the same conductance fraction from each Norton source: G_36/(G_6+G_12+G_36). Compute I=(15+5)·[(1/36)/(1/6+1/12+1/36)] downward, or equivalently add the two separate contributions, and round to one decimal place to obtain 2.0 A.

再推理：按指定方法，把左支路从主上节点与下节点看成 90 V 电源串联 6 Ω，等效为 Norton 源：电流为 90/6 = 15 A，并联电阻为 6 Ω，方向等效为向主上节点注入。把中间 60 V 电源串联 12 Ω 等效为 Norton 源：电流为 60/12 = 5 A，并联电阻为 12 Ω，方向也等效为向主上节点注入。此时 6 Ω、12 Ω、36 Ω 三个电阻并联，两个 Norton 电流源合计注入电流为 15 + 5 = 20 A。36 Ω 支路按电导分流，其电导分数为 (1/36)/(1/6 + 1/12 + 1/36)。计算分母：1/6 + 1/12 + 1/36 = 6/36 + 3/36 + 1/36 = 10/36。因此 36 Ω 支路电流 I = 20 × [(1/36)/(10/36)] = 20 × 1/10 = 2.0 A，方向与图中向下箭头一致。
